children: is in discussions over a potential purchase of global credit platform Octus from private equity firm Permira.

The UK exchange operator is talking about a purchase of Octus for about $3.5 billion, the company said in a statement  on Tuesday, confirming an earlier report from Bloomberg. No final agreement has been reached, and no transaction is guaranteed.
The potential acquisition of Octus would be immediately accretive to LSEG’s Data & Analytics and Group revenue growth. Any transaction would be subject to regulatory approval.
A representative for Permira declined to comment to Bloomberg.

title: London Stock Exchange in talks to buy credit platform Octus
